records.note: no trans-prisoner-housing data found for Niger State. Two candidate fetches were attempted and failed within the hard time budget: the US State Department 2023 Nigeria human-rights report (state.gov) returned a bot-block 'Technical Difficulties' page (HTTP 403), and a Human Rights Watch news URL on Nigeria's 'crossdressing' arrests 404'd (HRW 'Page Not Found'). No document was found stating whether Niger State places trans prisoners by birth sex or gender identity, nor any special unit, segregation practice, or documented case/ruling on trans inmates here; per the gap-filling rule, absence of evidence is reported as such and no add is claimed as verified.
